title: Knock Rate,
name: Knock Rate
t3: Less time walking, more time knocking.
def: How many doors you actually hit in an hour.

title: Contact Rate,
name: Contact Rate
t3: Time of day moves this more than anything.
def: How often a knock actually gets someone to the door.

title: Jones Effect,
name: Jones Effect
scale:
One sale.
A whole street warms up.
touch: Your last yes, two doors down.
t3: Knock around every sale before you move on.
formula: NEXT SALE ↑ WHEN THE NEIGHBOR ALREADY BOUGHT
def: People buy faster when the people next door already did.

title: Pitch Rate,
name: Pitch Rate
t3: Your opener decides this, not your close.
def: How many conversations make it past the doorstep.

title: Average Ticket,
name: Average Ticket
t3: Add-ons raise it, not more doors.
def: What a typical sale is actually worth.

title: Revenue per Knock,
name: Revenue per Knock
t3: The one number that ties effort to pay.
def: What every single knock is worth to you.

title: Assumptive Close,
name: Assumptive Close
t3: Ask a small detail, not a big yes.
formula: ASSUME THE YES → ASK THE DETAIL
def: Talk like they’ve decided, then ask when, not if.

title: One-Call Close,
name: One-Call Close
formula: CLOSE IT ON THE FIRST VISIT
def: Close while the interest is hot, not on a callback.

title: Puppy Dog Close,
name: Puppy Dog Close
touch: The moment they see the result.
t3: Giving something back feels like losing it.
formula: LET THEM TRY IT → THEY KEEP IT
def: Let them experience it first, then ask for the sale.

title: Takeaway Close,
name: Takeaway Close
t3: People want what’s being taken away.
formula: PULL IT BACK → THEY LEAN IN
def: Hint it might not be for them, and they start selling themselves.

title: Tie-Down Questions,
name: Tie-Down Questions
t3: Saying yes once makes the next yes easier.
def: Short questions that stack small agreements through the pitch.

title: Feel, Felt, Found,
name: Feel, Felt, Found
t3: You never argue, you just add proof.
def: Agree with the concern, show others had it, share what they found.

title: Warm Transfers,
name: Warm Transfer
t3: Interest cools the second you leave.
def: Hand an interested homeowner to a closer on the spot.

title: Trial Closes,
name: Trial Close
t3: You find the objection before the close, not at it.
def: Check how close they are before you ask for the sale.

title: Clawbacks,
name: Clawback
t3: Clean sales cancel less. Don’t oversell.
def: Commission you lose when a sale cancels after you’ve been paid.

title: Turf Cutting.
name: Turf Cutting
scale:
One map.
Every rep, their own streets.
t3: No double-knocked doors. No stepped-on reps.
def: Splitting the map so every rep has their own streets.
